outcomes.text: Students will strengthen their social-emotional skills.

codebook_issue: No general 'SEL skills' code; Y4 only has specific competencies, no umbrella code.
rationale: No specific SEL construct named; too vague to place under one Y4 code.

outcomes.text: Soft Skills — Social-emotional skills

rationale: Bare label/category name, not a stated result.

outcomes.text: Youth will demonstrate growth in all five CASEL competencies.

codebook_issue: References all five CASEL competencies at once; no single code covers the whole domain.
rationale: Names the whole Y4 domain, not one specific skill; too broad to code.

outcomes.text: Students will use a breathing strategy to calm down when angry.

rationale: Coping strategy for managing anger matches Y4.2 definition exactly.

outcomes.text: Participants will build life skills.

rationale: 'Life skills' commonly maps to independent-living skills, but is vague.

outcomes.text: Youth will report improved overall well-being.

rationale: General well-being matches Y8.7's flourishing/life-satisfaction definition.

outcomes.text: Improved academic performance

rationale: 'Academic performance' with no subject named goes to Y1.15 by rule.

outcomes.text: Students' grades will improve in core subjects.

rationale: Grades in unnamed subjects fit Y1.15 exactly.

outcomes.text: Increase in healthy behaviors

rationale: Vague but fits daily health-behavior definition best.

outcomes.text: Fund 20% of operations through government and foundation grants.

codebook_issue: No code for an organization's own funding mix/fiscal sustainability; forced onto A3.1.
rationale: Org fundraising target has no dedicated code; forced placement.

outcomes.text: Short-Term Fiscal Stability

codebook_issue: Same fiscal-sustainability gap as E010; also reads as a header, not a stated result.
rationale: Reads as a section header/label, not a stated result.

outcomes.text: Improved organizational visibility and brand recognition in Philadelphia.

rationale: Branding is a named low-confidence example; nearest home is program quality.

outcomes.text: Evaluation results show clear evidence linking the program to academic outcomes.

rationale: Statement about the evaluation itself, not a participant result.

outcomes.text: Improved data-sharing and reporting with school partners.

rationale: Data-sharing agreement with partners matches A3.2's include list.

outcomes.text: Neighbors will feel healthier physically.
Neighbors will feel healthier mentally and emotionally.

codebook_issue: Subject is 'neighbors' (general public), not a program participant population; no target-population fit.
rationale: Split physical vs mental/emotional; subject mismatch forces low confidence.

outcomes.text: Our communities become more accepting of cultural differences.

codebook_issue: No code for community-level (vs. individual participant) acceptance change.
rationale: Closest construct is Y4.5, but subject is community-wide, not participants.

outcomes.text: Healthier neighborhoods.
Greener neighborhoods.
Safer neighborhoods.

codebook_issue: Neighborhood-level health/environment/safety has no dedicated set of codes; forced onto individual or community-conditions codes.
rationale: Three distinct neighborhood-level results forced onto closest available codes.

outcomes.text: Increased audience attendance at community concerts.

rationale: Aggregate attendance count is a program-level reach output.

outcomes.text: Teachers report increased job satisfaction.

rationale: Job satisfaction fits staff well-being under A1.3.

outcomes.text: Volunteer coaches have a joyful, meaningful experience.

rationale: Volunteer well-being/experience maps to workforce well-being code.

outcomes.text: Teaching artists earn a sustainable income from program work.

codebook_issue: No code for contracted staff/artist income or compensation sustainability.
rationale: No income code for staff/contractors; forced onto workforce well-being.

outcomes.text: Teachers will learn three new arts-integration strategies.

rationale: Staff learning new strategies matches A1.1 definition directly.

outcomes.text: Teachers will use arts-integration strategies in at least two lessons per month.

rationale: Applying learned strategies in practice is A1.2's core definition.

outcomes.text: Students will increase their appreciation of classical music.

rationale: Appreciation reads as positive regard/enjoyment rather than sustained pursuit.

outcomes.text: Students will improve their technical dance skills (turns, extensions, alignment).

rationale: Named dance technique gain matches Y1.6's arts-learning definition.

outcomes.text: Students will feel comfortable visiting museums and cultural institutions.

rationale: Comfort with a cultural experience forced onto enjoyment code.

outcomes.text: Preserve and celebrate Afro-Brazilian cultural traditions for future generations.

codebook_issue: Statement is an organizational/community mission ('for future generations'), not an individual youth identity outcome.
rationale: Mission-level cultural preservation forced onto individual identity code.

outcomes.text: Students will choreograph an original dance piece.

rationale: Creating an original dance piece is self-expression/creation under Y2.5.

outcomes.text: Students will perform their original dance piece at a spring showcase.

rationale: Performing finished work matches Y2.5's Performing/Presenting process.

outcomes.text: Youth will create and follow a personal budget.

rationale: Budgeting matches Y7.6's example almost verbatim.

outcomes.text: Graduates will complete college.
Graduates will have manageable student-loan debt.

rationale: Split completion (Y1.18) from debt outcome, forced onto financial capability.

outcomes.text: Families will enroll in SNAP and WIC benefits.

rationale: Matches F2.1's own example (SNAP and public benefits) almost exactly.

outcomes.text: Students will take at least one action to protect local wildlife.

rationale: Individual pro-environmental action matches Y6.6 directly.

outcomes.text: Reduction in food waste from school meals.

rationale: Program/operational food-waste reduction forced onto environmental stewardship.

outcomes.text: Students will explain how photosynthesis works in the school garden.

rationale: Photosynthesis is life-science content; garden is the setting, not the outcome.

outcomes.text: Students will expand their professional network through mentor introductions.

rationale: Matches Y3.5's own example (expanding professional network) closely.

outcomes.text: Alumni leverage program relationships to access internships and jobs.

rationale: Named lever is program relationships/networks, per the mobility tie-breaker.

outcomes.text: Students will report higher educational aspirations.

rationale: Aspirations are explicitly included in Y5.5's purpose/future-orientation definition.

outcomes.text: Youth will develop an increased sense of possibility for their future.

rationale: Optimism about the future is core to Y5.5's definition.

outcomes.text: Students will be exposed to four art disciplines.

rationale: 'Exposed to' names a dosage/output, not a demonstrated result.

outcomes.text: Students will be exposed to careers in environmental science.

rationale: Career exposure matches Y7.1's career awareness/exploration definition.

outcomes.text: Students will improve spatial awareness and motor coordination through dance.

rationale: Motor coordination gain, with dance as the means/activity.

outcomes.text: Improved body image

codebook_issue: No dedicated code for body image; forced onto general self-worth.
rationale: Body image has no specific code; closest is general self-worth.

outcomes.text: Youth will get at least 8 hours of sleep on school nights.

rationale: Sleep hours are explicitly included under Y8.1 healthy daily habits.

outcomes.text: Students with IEPs will lead their own IEP meetings.

rationale: Matches Y5.6's own example verbatim.

outcomes.text: Students with disabilities will be placed in inclusive general-education classrooms.

rationale: Placement decision removes a participation barrier, matching A2.4.

outcomes.text: Families will receive school communications in their home language.

rationale: Home-language communications are explicitly included under A2.4.

outcomes.text: English learners will advance one WIDA proficiency level.

rationale: WIDA proficiency-level gain matches Y1.2's include list directly.

outcomes.text: Students demonstrate improvements in:

rationale: Sentence fragment/header with no stated result.

outcomes.text: After School and summer programs

rationale: Bare program name/label, not a result.

rationale: Data-collection/process note about evaluation logistics, not an outcome.

outcomes.text: Awareness

rationale: Single bare label, no stated result.

outcomes.text: Weekly 90-minute sessions led by teaching artists

rationale: Describes program activity/dosage structure, not a result.

outcomes.text: Increase skill sets

rationale: Too vague to code; no specific skill named.

rationale: Test-specific anxiety is a symptom-reduction outcome, though narrower than clinical use.

outcomes.text: Students will use a coping strategy before tests.

rationale: Using a coping strategy for stress matches Y4.2 directly.

outcomes.text: Program will maintain 85% average daily attendance.

rationale: Matches A2.5's own average-daily-attendance example verbatim.

outcomes.text: Participating students will reduce chronic absenteeism at school.

rationale: Matches Y1.13's own chronic-absenteeism example verbatim.

outcomes.text: Students will self-report that the program improved their grades.

rationale: Self-reported grade improvement still names the grades construct.

outcomes.text: Students will feel more confident in math class.

rationale: Math-specific confidence is routed to academic mindsets by rule.

outcomes.text: Youth will feel positive about their own sexuality.
Youth will manage their reproductive health.

rationale: Split identity acceptance (sexuality) from reproductive-health management.

outcomes.text: Students will improve their math scores.
Students will make new friends.

rationale: Example split statement: two distinct results, math and friendship.

outcomes.text: Youth will demonstrate improved frustration tolerance during homework time.
Youth will complete more assignments on time.

rationale: Frustration tolerance in homework is academic perseverance, not general regulation.

outcomes.text: Students will complete their homework.
Students will improve their reading level.

rationale: Two distinct results: homework behavior and a reading-skill gain.

outcomes.text: Teachers gain arts-integration skills.
Students show higher engagement.

rationale: Split teacher skill gain from vague, forced-placement student engagement.

outcomes.text: Parents will attend family workshops.
Parents will read to their children at home.

rationale: Two distinct family results: program participation and home learning routine.

outcomes.text: Developed grit/resilience.
Developed self-efficacy.
Developed sense of belonging.

rationale: Three named competencies split into self-discipline, self-efficacy, and belonging.

outcomes.text: Students will write and perform original poems.

rationale: Writing and performing poems is creative expression, not a stated skill gain.

outcomes.text: Improved academic and social success

rationale: Too vague to code, like the 'improve outcomes for students' example.

outcomes.text: Increased college enrollment and graduation

rationale: Y1.18's definition explicitly covers both enrolling in and completing college.

outcomes.text: Youth increase their confidence when speaking, debating, and solving problems.

rationale: General confidence across non-academic skill areas routes to Y5.4.
